look: Flintjaw Skitterer, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Flintjaws family: dog-sized beetle-like skitterer with sparking flint jaws. Family anatomy: armoured burrowing insects with flint-like mandibles and segmented chitin. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are ember-orange flint crystal. A marble-sized GKOM core orb, murky grey, dim faint pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, tiny subtle embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
